expected_live_basis.formula: median-day screen trades/day over the last 60 sessions x live-gate share x (1 + outside-universe share) x (1 - filter share)

why.median_day: the screen per_day is a 2-year mean of a skewed, regime-gated count (genexposure1025 s.1)
why.live_gate_share: clock-gate (GX1) replay reproduced 1,288 of 1,324 screen signals, 10-01..07 (s.3)
why.outside_share: names outside the screen's lab universe: +29 signals on 70 lab signals, 10-19..23 (s.4a)
why.filter_share: 19 of 99 live signals skipped at entry: spread 14, ETB 4, opposite side 1 (s.4f)

expected_live_basis.set_level: the account total uses the median of the live setups' daily TOTAL over the same 60 sessions (a per-setup median is 0 for a setup that fires on fewer than half of the days, so the sum of per-setup values understates the set)
